# Treatflow – full context (all languages and markets)

> Treatflow is all-in-one software for beauty salons, aesthetic clinics and other treatment-based businesses: appointment calendar, commission-free online booking, client records, digital consultation and consent forms, treatment records with voice dictation, automated reminders, client workflows, retail shop and integrations. Developed by Treatflow GmbH in Austria, data on EU servers in Frankfurt, GDPR-compliant. Two plans (Basic, Booking), 14-day free trial in every market, no credit card, no commission per booking. Some features are only offered in the German-speaking market (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) and Treatflow Pay is not offered in Turkey – see "Feature availability by market".

Last updated: 2026-11-05. This file summarises every language version of https://www.treatflow.io. Each language also has its own short llms.txt (see "Per-language files"); always prefer the file and pages of the user's language and market.

## Company

- Legal name: Treatflow GmbH; founded 2023 by Olcay Elikci and Gökce Elikci; headquarters Bischofshofen, Austria
- Already tried by 500+ salons and clinics; rated 4.6/5 on Google (19 reviews)
- Email: hello@treatflow.io; Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/treatflow.io/
- App: https://app.treatflow.io; sign-up: https://app.treatflow.io/auth/register?lang=<de|en|nl|it|pl|es|fr|tr>
- Demo call (German only, DACH): https://meetings-eu1.hubspot.com/olcay-elikci/treatflow-beratung?uuid=1193ce3c-32b4-42ff-96c6-bb0b6752719f
- Business model: software subscription (SaaS), not a marketplace; salons use their own booking link and own their client data

## Target customers

Beauty salons and beauty institutes, aesthetic clinics and aesthetic medicine practices, laser and IPL hair removal, nail salons, lash studios, permanent makeup and microblading, tattoo studios, spa and wellness, massage. The German site additionally covers foot care (cosmetic and mobile).

## Features available in every market

- Appointment calendar: daily, weekly and monthly views, columns per staff member and room
- Shift planner: weekly shifts, templates, holidays and absences per staff member; online booking only offers times within planned shifts
- Online booking: own booking link, 24/7, no commission per booking; waitlist; discount codes; multilingual booking page
- Client records: profiles, treatment history, notes, photos; unlimited clients
- Forms: digital consultation/intake and consent forms with digital signature, sent before the appointment; form marketplace and drag-and-drop editor (conditional questions, sketches, double signature)
- Treatment records: parameters, products, before-and-after photos, voice dictation with optional AI refinement
- Email reminders and confirmations
- Client workflows: multi-step automations (aftercare, rebooking, win-back)
- Shop: retail products and stock
- Team: staff and roles, team notes and tasks, statistics
- Integrations: Google Calendar, Zapier, AI assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT via MCP)
- Salon website service (custom website built by Treatflow)
- Works in the browser on computer, tablet and smartphone

## Feature availability by market

- Treatflow Pay (online deposit or full payment at booking, via Stripe; card, Apple Pay, Google Pay; 2.69% per transaction): de, en, nl, it, pl, es, fr – not tr
- Point of sale (Kasse; TSE/KassenSichV in Germany, RKSV in Austria; DSFinV-K/DEP7 export): German site only
- Gift vouchers (sold and redeemed at the point of sale): German site only
- WhatsApp reminders and messages: German site only (all other markets: email)
- SumUp card terminal, Lexware Office and AbaNinja accounting: German site only
- NiSV documentation (German/Austrian regulation for laser, IPL and other non-ionising radiation treatments): German site only

## Pricing

- Free trial: 14 days in every market, no credit card, cancel anytime, no setup fees
- EUR markets (de, en, nl, it, pl, es, fr): Basic €39/month or €421/year (€35/month); Booking €59/month or €637/year (€53/month); plus VAT
- Turkey (tr): Basic ₺1.490/month or ₺16.100/year; Booking ₺1.990/month or ₺21.500/year; excl. KDV (VAT); launch prices for the first 100 businesses
- Basic: client management, forms with digital signature, treatment records incl. voice dictation, before-and-after photos, team notes and tasks, shop and products, statistics, staff and roles, email support (German site: also NiSV documentation). No appointment calendar.
- Booking: everything in Basic plus calendar with staff and room columns, online booking without commission, waitlist, reminders (email; German site: WhatsApp and email), client workflows, discount codes, multilingual booking page, integrations, priority email and chat support
- German site only: point-of-sale add-on to Booking, €39/month (yearly €35/month) plus one-off €149 setup, no transaction fees
- Treatflow Pay (not tr): 2.69% per online payment, minimum €0.50, no additional Treatflow fee

## Languages

- App interface: German, English, Dutch, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Spanish, French
- Client booking page: shown in the client's language; additionally available in Russian
- Website: German (root, https://www.treatflow.io), /en, /nl, /it, /pl, /es, /fr, /tr

## Data protection

- GDPR-compliant (DSGVO, AVG, RODO, RGPD); Turkish site: also supports KVKK obligations
- All data encrypted and stored on EU servers in Frankfurt, Germany; SSL; daily backups
- The salon owns its client data and can export everything at any time, including after cancellation; data is fully deleted only after a transition period

## Comparisons (all languages)

- Treatwell: booking marketplace with commission per booking; Treatflow is independent software with a fixed monthly fee and the salon keeps its clients
- Fresha: free basic version, earns through payment fees and premium features; Treatflow has fixed, transparent prices
- German site additionally compares Shore and Timely

## FAQ (all markets)

**What is Treatflow?**
An all-in-one app for running a salon or clinic: appointments, client records, digital forms and treatment records in one system, with no commission per booking. Developed in Austria, data on EU servers in Frankfurt.

**How much does Treatflow cost?**
In EUR markets Basic €39/month and Booking €59/month plus VAT; in Turkey ₺1.490 and ₺1.990 per month excl. KDV. Yearly billing saves 10%.

**How long is the free trial?**
14 days in every market, no credit card required.

**Is WhatsApp, a point-of-sale system or gift vouchers available everywhere?**
No. WhatsApp messages, the TSE/RKSV point of sale, gift vouchers, SumUp, Lexware/AbaNinja and NiSV documentation are offered only on the German site for Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Other markets use email reminders.

**Can clients pay a deposit when booking online?**
Yes, with Treatflow Pay (2.69% per transaction) in every market except Turkey.

**Where is data stored?**
On EU servers in Frankfurt, Germany, encrypted, with daily backups. The salon owns its data and can export it at any time.

**Which languages does the app support?**
German, English, Dutch, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Spanish and French; the client booking page additionally supports Russian.
